question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.

My nephew is the most naughtiest kid on this Earth.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the redundancy in using both "**most**" and "**naughtiest**."
 
• The word "**naughtiest**" itself is a superlative adjective and does not require the word "**most**" before it.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**the naughtiest kid**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**My nephew is the naughtiest kid on this Earth."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "naughtiest kid"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 4.
 
• **3: "on this Earth."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "My nephew is the most"** – This part of the sentence contains the error due to redundancy in using "most" with "naughtiest".
